Job Title: Senior Backend & Cloud Engineer

About the Role:
We are looking for a talented software engineer to build scalable microservices.

Requirements:
- Strong proficiency in Python and C++
- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for container orchestration
- Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS)
- Deep understanding of PostgreSQL and Redis caching
- Familiarity with building REST APIs and CI/CD automation
- Excellent grasp of Data Structures & Algorithms

Nice to have:
- React or frontend exposure
- Machine Learning experience
